question.text: In India, exchange-traded currency derivatives are traded on which exchanges?

answer.text: NSE, BSE, and Metropolitan Stock Exchange of India Ltd. (MSEI)
NSE and Multi Commodity Exchange (MCX) only
BSE and National Commodity and Derivatives Exchange (NCDEX) only

explanation.text: The Logic: Page 21 of the NISM Series I Currency Derivatives workbook (December 2025) lists NSE, BSE, and Metropolitan Stock Exchange of India Ltd. (MSEI) as the exchanges on which currency futures trade in India. The same page notes that spot, forwards, and swaps remain OTC, while options trade both OTC and on exchanges. The Trap: The other options either name an incorrect exchange or omit MSEI, which is one of the three recognised currency-derivatives venues. Note: The earlier rationale that "MCX handles commodity derivatives, not currency derivatives" is not stated on page 21 and is not used here.
